source_title: Inside vLLM’s New KV Offloading Connector: Smarter Memory Transfer for Maximizing Inference Throughput
source_section: Changing vLLM’s Memory Layout, physical block size table
quantity: Physical K+V bytes for one token block across all layers; not a prefill peak or a GPU context boundary
caveats: The publication labels its units MB/KB without explicitly defining decimal versus binary units. Both interpretations must be reported.
The 2-byte cache dtype is an explicit compatibility assumption; fp16 and bf16 have the same byte width. The comparison does not validate cache quantization.
Base and Instruct KV architecture fields are checked against separately pinned official configs before comparison.
The table is rounded/truncated; percentage error against displayed values is not measurement uncertainty.
External evidence checks only the KV submodel. It cannot validate transferred HF efficient-SDPA peak context limits.
